name: Question 3
problem:
Determine whether the following differential equation is exact:

$$
(4+{y}^{2}{e}^{xy})\,\text{d}x+(x{e}^{xy}+3y)\,\text{d}y=0
$$

A differential equation of the form

$$
P(x,y)\,\text{d}x+Q(x,y)\,\text{d}y=0
$$

is exact if it satisfies the condition

$$
\,{{field-1}},
$$
